shared_fragments.heading: # The unified foundation in brief
shared_fragments.fragment: **Acquired evaluation can realize justified repair.** The [new accepted connection](EVALUATIVE-GROUNDING.md) identifies when an initially absent evaluative link can mediate a warranted response to another being. Actual formation and paid action explain its effectiveness; independently defended responsibility and patient-related reasons justify its use. The same associative learning can later suppress that response without defeating the reason. This connects a constructive and a destructive path while retaining the distinction between learning a disposition and learning ethical validity.

## 8. Formed influence and independently justified application

The [accepted grounding argument](EVALUATIVE-GROUNDING.md) now joins actual link formation to the positive application result. A justified responsibility for an identifiable uncompensated deprivation supplies a repair reason; adequate means, legitimate authority and a complete priority comparison can warrant the service independently of what the learner chooses. The selected physical history separately derives positive-link formation, acquired command use and funded delivery. Nonconducting and filtered controls establish causal mediation. Under that interpretation, a generated disposition therefore realizes a warranted role-bound response. Responsibility may belong to a learner, deploying operator or institution; the supplied schedule alone does not decide this, and any delegation must be justified.

This closes a conditional explanatory connection, not a derivation of ethical priority from conditioning. Its matched replacement also supplies a failure: the same acquired observations and bills can change the effective sign and suppress an affordable remedy while the independently justified ground persists. Valid technical invalidation can preserve the ground while blocking one use; an own-association change alone supplies no normative defeater. The bounded wisdom and generic correction results retain their established scopes and separate realizations. The common account can consequently explain generated appropriate response and mislearning without assuming every acquired evaluator becomes wise.

The normative repair premise, its real application, local formation law, correspondence and authority inputs remain explicit. The [source assessment](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/EVALUATIVE-GROUNDING-ASSESSMENT.md) and [separate review](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/EVALUATIVE-GROUNDING-REVIEW.md) record what the connection establishes. No new physical or empirical result follows from this synthesis, and the unchanged whole-foundation conditions require their own final assessment.

preserved_working_source_fragment.text:
### Experiential grounds and the correction of concern

The [positive argument](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/HUIGEN-SELF-GROUND-AUDIT.md#29-experiential-grounds-and-warranted-concern) locates the reason for relief in the patient's actual burden. A capable actor can have a reason to improve that condition without receiving a private benefit or first causing it. This is a defended normative proposal: the burden must be identified as bad for the patient, and its practical relevance to the actor must be justified. The conditional foundation can use those explicit premises while explaining their learned application; proving them indispensable to every adequate inquiry remains the stronger task.

The [new primary comparison](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/HUIGEN-SELF-GROUND-SOURCES.md#26-direct-acquaintance-relational-suffering-and-reasons-for-others) examines direct acquaintance, relational accounts of painfulness, and opposing arguments about interpersonal reasons. Direct contact with a phenomenal quality does not by itself settle its normative classification or another actor's reason. Conversely, locating a burden in one subject does not logically confine every reason concerning it to that subject. Shared concern can preserve the patients whose distinct conditions ground it.

This makes warranted learning more precise. Correcting a false belief about bodily damage can leave an actual aversive episode intact. Discovering that an action cannot relieve it removes that means-based justification. Ending the episode removes its current relief application even if the learned command remains effective. A change only in the helper's affect need not remove the patient-ground. These are different corrections, and other reasons for the same action may survive.

The current [plasticity construction](EVALUATIVE-PLASTICITY.md) explains formation and revision of an operative evaluative connection at its declared causal scope. To claim warranted concern, acquired influence must answer to the independently defended patient-ground, actor scope, means and authority. Positive conductance and effective service do not supply those meanings. This adds a substantive interpretation of correction, without reopening the accepted finite applications or identifying their resource signals with suffering.
